scope: Legacy SSH transport retirement and safe compatible backend/node service maintenance. Node framing is retained; nodejs is the runtime.
recoveryAndSafety: OS-backed per-user upgrade lock and durable operation records
Checksum, immutable package fingerprint and fresh zero-finding production audit before stopping
Backend/node maintenance guards while switching and checking new code
Known native server forms/permissions checked before configuration reload; none approved or cancelled
Private integrity-checked SQLite backups and credential/configuration snapshots
Only selected service/configuration/CLI pointers switched; no OpenCode shutdown
Failed health restores compatible code/configuration, not a database snapshot
Uncertain/racing work and later user edits are never discarded to force rollback
Persisted partial-switch recovery reuses the exact original operation

installedPackagePreflight.limitation: Dirty-source preflight, not the final clean-commit release report

limits: Only explicitly compatible schema-1 maintenance, not arbitrary schema migration
Native decision inspection covers known bound/registered services; client-only dialogs and late races can still be invalidated by configuration reload
Not physical Surface certification or full crash/recovery certification
